info.title: Assignment Gateway Public API
info.description: Definitions for Assignment Gateway Public API

get.description: Endpoint for discovering all OpenId Connect endpoints

post.description: Endpoint for exchanging credentials for tokens (access token and ID token)

get.description: Endpoint for fetching JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) to verify the retrieved tokens

post.description: Post an assignment attempt to sign on / sign off a vehicle.

get.description: Find journeys for a given set of search criteria.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: General-purpose search parameter that can accept various identifiers like vehicle journey ID (e.g., "86"), journey references,  or pattern references to return matching journeys with their associated details including external IDs and pattern references.

parameters.name: fromDateTime
parameters.description: First arrival / departure date in ISO 8601 date-time format with time-zone offset. If not set, search result may be limited to current day.

parameters.name: toDateTime
parameters.description: Last arrival / departure date in ISO 8601 date-time format with time-zone offset. If not set, search result may be limited to current day.

2xx.description: Response containing a list of journey items matching search criteria.

4xx.description: Response containing a list of journey items matching search criteria.

5xx.description: Response containing a list of journey items matching search criteria.

get.description: Return list of unique lines matching search criteria.

2xx.description: Response containing a list of line items.

4xx.description: Response containing a list of line items.

5xx.description: Response containing a list of line items.

get.description: Return list of unique stop points matching search criteria.

2xx.description: Response containing a list of stop point items.

4xx.description: Response containing a list of stop point items.

5xx.description: Response containing a list of stop point items.

get.description: Return a list of service deviations matching a given set of criteria.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: General-purpose search parameter that can accept various identifiers.

post.description: Post a service deviation registration request

get.description: Return a service deviation with a given id.

post.description: Update a service deviation with a given id.

get.description: Return a list of service deviation reason codes
Return a list of service mitigations matching a given set of criteria.

post.description: Post a service mitigation registration request

get.description: Return a service mitigation with a given id.

post.description: Update a service mitigation with a given id.

ADTAuthHeader.name: X-ADT-Auth
ADTAuthHeader.description: Internal authentication metadata used by system implementation. Any value set here by a client will be ignored.

TraceIdHeader.name: X-Trace-Id
TraceIdHeader.description: Optional trace id for request. May be used to trace multiple requests as part of the same "operation" or "process". If set, should be different from `X-Request-Id` header.

ClientIdHeader.name: X-Client-Id
ClientIdHeader.description: Optional client id for request. May be used to identify client system by name or other identifier. Note that this is only treated as additional process metadata and not connected to authorization in any way.

RequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-Id
RequestIdHeader.description: Optional request id for request. Request id provided by client should be unique per request. For identifying multiple requests as belonging to the same group of requests when doing retries, parallel request processing or similar, see `X-Trace-Id` header.

OperatorIdHeader.name: X-Operator-Id
OperatorIdHeader.description: Optional operator id for request. Required by clients with access to more than one PTO.  Operator id on the form 'CodeSpace:Operator:number' Ref: https://enturas.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PUBLIC/pages/637370434/List+of+current+Codespaces

AuthorityIdHeader.name: X-Authority-Id
AuthorityIdHeader.description: Optional authority id for request. Required by clients with access to more than one PTA. Ref: https://enturas.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PUBLIC/pages/637370434/List+of+current+Codespaces

DatedServiceJourneyIdPathParam.name: datedServiceJourneyId
DatedServiceJourneyIdPathParam.description: Unique identifier of a dated service journey.

StopPointQueryParam.name: stopPoint
StopPointQueryParam.description: Filters journeys by stop point identifier. Accepts various stop point identifiers such as NSR:Quay IDs (e.g., "NSR:Quay:109233") and returns journeys that serve the specified stop point, including details like stop name (e.g., "Nationaltheatret"), public code, and related stop area references.

VehicleTaskQueryParam.name: vehicleTask
VehicleTaskQueryParam.description: Filters journeys by vehicle task identifier. Accepts a numeric vehicle task ID (e.g., "1702") to return journeys associated with the specified vehicle task.

VehicleIdQueryParam.name: vehicleId
VehicleIdQueryParam.description: Filters journeys by vehicle id identifier. Accepts a string to return journeys associated with the specified vehicle id.

LineTaskQueryParam.name: line
LineTaskQueryParam.description: Filters journeys by line identifier. Accepts a line number or code (e.g., "70") and returns journeys operating on that line, including details like line reference ("RUT:Line:70"), public code, and transport mode information.

LatQueryParam.name: lat
LatQueryParam.description: Specifies the latitude coordinate for location-based journey queries. Used in combination with the 'lon' parameter to find journeys near a specific geographic location.

LonQueryParam.name: lon
LonQueryParam.description: Specifies the longitude coordinate for location-based journey queries. Used in combination with the 'lat' parameter to find journeys near a specific geographic location.

LimitQueryParam.name: limit
LimitQueryParam.description: Maximum number of items to return in response.

FromDateTime.name: fromDateTime
FromDateTime.description:
Optional dateTime to filter out deviations before this point in time. ISO-8601 format,
including time-zone offset (format: _YYYY-MM-DD_T_hh:mm:ssZ_)

ToDateTime.name: toDateTime
ToDateTime.description:
Optional dateTime to filter out deviations after this point in time. ISO-8601 format,
including time-zone offset (format: _YYYY-MM-DD_T_hh:mm:ssZ_)

IncludeCallsQueryParam.name: includeCalls
IncludeCallsQueryParam.description: Flag indicating if returned journeys should include call data or not (default: `false`).

AssignmentAttemptRequestSignOff.title: AssignmentAttemptRequestSignOff
AssignmentAttemptRequestSignOff.description: Request to sign the vehicle out from assigned journey. The result is effective immediately. It signals that the vehicle will no longer service journey.

AssignmentAttemptRequestSignOn.title: AssignmentAttemptRequestSignOn
AssignmentAttemptRequestSignOn.description: Attempt to sign the vehicle on to a specified vehicle task or one or more journey(s).

DateTimeRange.title: DateTimeRange
DateTimeRange.description: A date-time range with a start date-time and an end date-time.

start.description: Start of date-time range in ISO-8601 format, including time-zone offset (format: _YYYY-MM-DD_T_hh:mm:ssZ_).

end.description: End of date-time range in ISO-8601 format, including time-zone offset (format: _YYYY-MM-DD_T_hh:mm:ssZ_).

FeatureLevel.title: FeatureLevel
FeatureLevel.description: Feature level as defined by https://avtaleomdigitaletjenester.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DS/pages/2523824129/KUNNGJORT+Avtale+om+Digitale+Tjenester+v.+4.0#Funksjonsniv%C3%A5er If the Feature level is not specified, Feature Level COMPLETE is assumed.
example: COMPLETE # Complete feature level, the vehicle meets all requirements in the given ADT version
LEGACY   # Legacy feature level, as defined by ADT 4.0 Funksjonsnivåer
LIGHT    # Light feature level, as defined by ADT 4.0 Funksjonsnivåer

vehicleTaskId.description: An id produced in planning to identify a collection of journeys

calls.description: Calls serviced by this journey. Note that call list may be empty or non-present (`null`) if journey was retrieved without call details.

destinationDisplayText.description: Destination display text to use at this call.

JourneyCallBehaviourTypeCode.title: JourneyCallBehaviourTypeCode
JourneyCallBehaviourTypeCode.description: Behaviour type code for a journey stop point call.
examples: NO_SERVICE         # Stop point is not serviced
FULL_SERVICE       # Stop point is serviced (boarding and alighting)
FOR_BOARDING_ONLY  # Only boarding allowed at stop point
FOR_ALIGHTING_ONLY # Only alighting allowed at stop point

arrivalDateTime.description: Planned arrival date and time of call in ISO-8601 datetime format (`YYYY-DD-MMThh:mm:ssZ`) with time-zone.

departureDateTime.description: Planned departure date and time of call in ISO-8601 datetime format (`YYYY-DD-MMThh:mm:ssZ`) with time-zone.

JourneyDeviationState.title: JourneyDeviationState
JourneyDeviationState.description: Operational deviation state of a journey.

omitted.description: Flag indicating the complete journey has been omitted by operator: a deviation with code `NO_SERVICE` is active

partiallyOmitted.description: Flag indicating one or more calls in the journey has been omitted by operator: a deviation with code `NO_SERVICE` and a call list of omitted calls is active

operatingWithoutSignOn.description: Flag indicating operator has notified that they will not be signing on to this journey: a deviation with code `NO_SIGN_ON` is active

serviceDeviations.description: List of references to service deviations currently active on this journey.

JourneyDirectionCode.title: JourneyDirectionCode
JourneyDirectionCode.description: Line direction code, indicating direction of line relative to city center.

vehicleJourneyId.description: Vehicle journey id assigned by PTA traffic planner. Reused across multiple operating dates.

serviceJourneyId.description: Service journey id assigned by PTA back-end system. Reused across multiple operating dates.

datedServiceJourneyId.description: Dated service journey id assigned by PTA back-end system. Unique for a specific service journey on a specific date.

JourneyLine.title: JourneyLine
JourneyLine.description: A journey line with id and name.

JourneyMitigationState.title: JourneyMitigationState
JourneyMitigationState.description: Operational mitigation state of a journey.

cancelled.description: Flag indicating journey has been cancelled by traffic controller and communicated as cancelled to the public.

partiallyCancelled.description: Flag indicating journey has been partially cancelled by traffic controller and communicated as partially cancelled to the public.

standbyVehiclePlanned.description: Flag indicating traffic controller has planned an alternative (stand by) vehicle on this journey.

serviceMitigations.description: List of references to service mitigations currently active on this journey.

JourneyServiceVarianceReference.title: JourneyServiceVarianceReference
JourneyServiceVarianceReference.description: A reference to a service variance such as a service deviation or a service mitigation.

ref.description: Reference to a service deviation or service mitigation.

code.description: A service deviation code or service mitigation code.

journeyId.description: Identifier referencing journey, such as `serviceJourneyId`, `vehicleJourneyId` or `datedServiceJourneyId`.

firstDepartureDateTime.description: Planned Departure Time from the Initial Call

assigned.description: Flag indicating journey is currently assigned to one more vehicles, i.e. at least one vehicle is currently signed on this journey.

MetadataEntry.title: MetadataEntry
MetadataEntry.description: A key/value pair describing arbitrary metadata for the given MetadataKey.

operatorId.description: Unique operator id as assigned to operator by PTA, corresponding to `{operatorId}` parameter of MQTT topics.  This value will be used for any async call-back message sent from the PTA to the PTO

authorityId.description: Unique authority id for the PTA, corresponding to the `{authorityId}` parameter of MQTT topics. This value will be used for any async call-back message sent from the PTA to the PTO. Example: 'ruter'

vehicleId.description: Unique vehicle id, corresponding to `{vehicleId}` parameter of MQTT topics.  This id might be different from the vehicleId provided in the AssignmentAttemptRequest. Mostly the two would be the same. This value will be used for any async call-back message sent from the PTA to the PTO.

PageInfo.title: PageInfo
PageInfo.description: Paging info of a returned find / search result.

limit.description: Limit value used for processing request.

offset.description: Offset value used for processing request.

itemCount.description: Number of result items in `items` array.

ServiceDeviationCode.title: ServiceDeviationCode
ServiceDeviationCode.description: Service deviation code, indicating type of service deviation.
example: BYPASS           # A call is not serviced, but bypassed due to lack of waiting passengers or other reason.
NO_SERVICE       # Journey(s), line(s) or call(s) will not be serviced by operator.
NO_SIGN_ON       # Planned journey(s), line(s) or call(s) will be serviced, but operator will not sign on.

ServiceDeviationLifeCycleInfo.title: ServiceDeviationLifeCycleInfo
ServiceDeviationLifeCycleInfo.description: Life-cycle information about a service deviation.

created.description: Date and time when service deviation was initially created.

modified.description: Date and time when service deviation was last modified.

vehicleId.description: Optional identifier of vehicle to which the service deviation applies.

delayMinutes.description: Number of minutes of expected delay, relative to planned arrival / departure time.

operatorExempt.description: Flag indicating that operator is exempt from consequences of reported service deviation.

updateAssignedVehicles.description: Update vehicle state for assigned vehicles impacted by this deviation.

ServiceDeviationReason.title: ServiceDeviationReason
ServiceDeviationReason.description: Service deviation reason, indicating reason for service deviation.

code.description: Service deviation reason code. Allowed values depends on deviation code, operator and active configuration. A list of available codes can be obtained via API look-up.

comment.description: Optional, human-readable, reason comment, if applicable.

ServiceDeviationReasonCodeSpec.title: ServiceDeviationReasonCodeSpec
ServiceDeviationReasonCodeSpec.description: Specification for a service deviation reason code.

code.description: Service deviation reason code for in deviation registrations.

description.description: Detailed description of reason code, if any.

groupCode.description: Code indicating service deviation reason group to which this reason code belongs.

validDeviationCodes.description: List of service deviation codes for which this reason code is valid.

ServiceDeviationReasonGroupSpec.title: ServiceDeviationReasonGroupSpec
ServiceDeviationReasonGroupSpec.description: Specification for a service deviation reason code.

code.description: Service deviation reason group code code.

description.description: Detailed description of reason code, if any.

ServiceMitigationCode.title: ServiceMitigationCode
ServiceMitigationCode.description: Service mitigation code, indicating type of service mitigation.

ServiceMitigationLifeCycleInfo.title: ServiceMitigationLifeCycleInfo
ServiceMitigationLifeCycleInfo.description: Life-cycle information about a service deviation.

created.description: Date and time when service deviation was initially created.

modified.description: Date and time when service deviation was last modified.

transportMode.description: Transport mode of the replacement/new journey(s). Only BUS is supported.

updateAssignedVehicles.description: Update vehicle state for assigned vehicles impacted by this mitigation.

replacements.description: A list of the replacement journeys

StatusResponseCode.title: StatusResponseCode
StatusResponseCode.description: Machine readable specifications of the code supplied. The list of examples might not be complete.

StatusResponseReasonCode.title: StatusResponseReasonCode
StatusResponseReasonCode.description: Machine readable specifications of the code supplied. The list of examples might not be complete.
example: INFO                           # Informational only. Description field(s) may contain additional details.
WARNING                        # Warning only. Description fields may contain additional details.
BAD_REQUEST                    # The provided request contained one or more error(s).
CALL_SPEC_ERROR                # Missing or invalid call specification(s).
LINE_SPEC_ERROR                # Missing or invalid line specification(s).
JOURNEY_SPEC_ERROR             # Missing or invalid journey specification(s)
SERVICE_WINDOW_ERROR           # Missing or invalid service window(s) in specification(s).
STOP_POINT_SPEC_ERROR          # Missing or invalid stop point specification(s)
CALL_NOT_FOUND                 # No call(s) matching provided specification(s).
LINE_NOT_FOUND                 # No line(s) matching provided specification(s).
JOURNEY_NOT_FOUND              # No journey(s) matching provided specification(s).
STOP_POINT_NOT_FOUND           # No stop point(s) matching provided specification(s).
VEHICLE_ID_ERROR               # Missing or invalid vehicle id in request.
OPERATOR_ID_ERROR              # Missing or invalid operator id in request.
DEVIATION_CODE_ERROR           # Missing or invalid service deviation code.
DEVIATION_REASON_CODE_ERROR    # Missing or invalid service deviation reason code.
MITIGATION_CODE_ERROR          # Missing or invalid service mitigation code.
ASSIGNMENT_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED     # Assignment attempt has expired (timeout error).
ASSIGNMENT_SIGN_OFF_CODE_ERROR # Missing or invalid assignment attempt sign-off code.

quayId.description: Unique identifier of (NSR) quay, if any. May also be an internal quay id not officially registered in NSR, such a garage or vehicle depot.

stopPointId.description: Unique id of stop point. May be used as an alternative to quayId if stop point has no quay id or quay id is knot known.

segmentCount.description: Optional segment count indicating number of logical segments for multi-segment vehicles. This may be used for vehicles such as articulated buses, multi-segment trams or metro trains consisting of multiple carriages or multiple carriage sets.

assigned.description: True if vehicle is currently assigned.

adtVersion.description: Current ADT version for vehicle, as determined by last (successful) sign-on from this vehicle.

journeys.description: List of dated service journeys assigned to the vehicle, if any.

description.description: Human readable description of the last action performed that changed the state of the vehicle assignment
